_comment: Providers that extend eu19-transit-motis to the rest of Europe. Added to a session with scripts/session_providers.py --add (dry run by default). Every entry is fetched automatically on each 'Refresh providers' - none is a manual upload. 'provenance' says where the data comes from and is repeated in the label so it shows wherever the provider is listed: nap = listed on the country's MMTIS National Access Point; official = published by the operator or a government body but not (yet) confirmed on a NAP; community = built by volunteers from the operator's website, used only where no official feed exists. 'probe' records the 2026-10-02 check from the VPS. Research: docs/eu-extension-providers.md.

providers.label: Iarnrod Eireann [official, NAP unconfirmed]
providers.probe: GTFS, 19 rail routes incl. Dublin-Belfast Enterprise, calendar to 2026-12-12

providers.label: VR (Fintraffic Digitraffic) [official, NAP unconfirmed]
providers.probe: GTFS, 744 rail routes, calendar to 2027-12-31; the server answers 406 unless the request accepts gzip (the app's client does)

providers.label: Elron [official, NAP unconfirmed]
providers.probe: GTFS, 28 rail routes incl. Tallinn-Riga, calendar to 2026-12-31

providers.label: Lithuania all operators (visimarsrutai.lt) [official, NAP unconfirmed]
providers.probe: GTFS 65 MB, 3480 routes of which 73 rail; calendar end 2099-12-31 is a placeholder

providers.label: HZ Putnicki prijevoz [official, NAP unconfirmed]
providers.probe: GTFS, 143 routes of which 138 rail, calendar to 2026-12-13

providers.label: Italo (NTV) + ItaloBus
providers.probe: gzip-compressed NeTEx (188 KB), unpacked by app/feed_fetch.py like Trenord; stops are known to be listed out of order - check the build

providers.label: Belgrade city + suburban transit [official, no NAP]
providers.nap_reference: https://data.gov.rs (Secretariat for Public Transport, City of Belgrade)
providers.probe: GTFS 17 MB, 241 tram/trolleybus/bus routes, calendar to 2029-12-31

providers.label: Tirana city transit [official, no NAP]
providers.probe: not probed from the VPS; mirror copy: 27 routes, calendar to 2026-12-31
